text: Bind every final claim to a stable source span and a concrete falsifying check.
rationale: Makes unsupported prose refusable without adding a separate report-validation pass.

text: Require each bespoke helper to declare the uncovered behavior and expected counterexample it targets.
rationale: Separates guidance gaps from execution errors and exposes unchanged-surface tests.

text: Compare report pointers with the changed-surface set during acceptance, explaining every zero-delta mismatch.
rationale: Proves final pointer inspection covered the actual design scope.
trap: Every zero-delta mismatch explanation creates ceremony; unchanged source may still require tests.

text: Treat exact wording, model strings, and JSONPath expressions as interface claims grounded in their owning schema.
rationale: Prevents brittle assertions from masquerading as substantive verification.

text: Classify every helper failure against a cited rule and reproducible input before changing the guidance.
rationale: Creates an auditable distinction between execution defects and guidance defects.

text: Map reused evidence to affected behaviors and identify the precise uncovered behavior before adding a new check.
rationale: Preserves proof while curbing redundant packaging and prose checks.

text: Ship a failure postcard beside each worker result: source pointer, affected invariant, replay command, and safe recovery action.
rationale: A night responder follows one bounded path instead of reverse-engineering prose.
trap: Extra postcard duplicates report and replay entitlement cannot be implied.

text: Route wording, model identifiers, and JSON-path extraction through one typed comparison vocabulary instead of per-script conventions.
rationale: Observed mismatch shapes become diagnosable without weakening source-checked proof.
trap: Typed vocabulary is new machinery for heterogeneous semantics.

text: Have acceptance replay the worker’s affected proof slice while independently inspecting cited source and report pointers.
rationale: Valid evidence is reused without removing substantive checks or independent acceptance.
trap: Unconditional replay conflicts with applicable evidence reuse.

text: Make every helper failure name its violated semantic layer—token, path, pointer, or output shape—before raw details.
rationale: The first failure line identifies the repair surface.

text: Generate the final report from the same structured facts acceptance inspects, with prose as a rendering layer.
rationale: Pointer drift and sentence disagreement surface at the data boundary.
trap: New structured rendering model adds runtime.

text: When parsing fails, emit a complete read-only diagnostic bundle and stop before unrelated packaging work begins.
rationale: Malformed input becomes a bounded handoff instead of collateral 3am work.
trap: Blanket stop and diagnostic bundle inflate local failures.

text: Make each helper serialize evidence to JSON, render prose, then feed the prose back through a second parser before acceptance.
rationale: Negate the round trip by keeping typed evidence as verification input and rendering prose once at the reporting boundary.

text: Bind assertions to exact sentence order and model spelling so every wording cleanup reopens substantive verification.
rationale: Negate incidental coupling with normalized semantic fields and source-anchored claim checks.
trap: Normalizing exact model literals can break sealed routes.

text: Package a fresh copy of every unchanged product file during a design-only task, then compare generated bytes as if implementation changed.
rationale: Negate false churn by packaging only affected surfaces while retaining required packaging checks.
trap: Partial packaging cannot replace complete package verification.

text: Resolve reused evidence from a moving source checkout after recording its pointer, creating stale-pointer repair loops.
rationale: Negate temporal drift by resolving one immutable source snapshot through report and acceptance.

text: Make independent acceptance consume a different serialization of the same report, forcing ownership handoffs over formatting defects.
rationale: Negate cross-format repair by sharing one canonical report model while keeping acceptance independent.
trap: Canonical serialization adds structure beyond actual report contract.

text: Translate JSON paths through a string-only helper that silently changes arrays and objects, turning valid evidence into type failures.
rationale: Negate coercion by preserving JSON values and rejecting type changes at the narrow boundary.

text: Treat repository test assertions as the drafting keyboard: a read-only extractor emits exact wording/model literals and source spans for paste-in, never paraphrase.
rationale: The next checker consumes authoritative literals, separating guidance drift from product behavior.
trap: Extractor creates new maintenance and copies test assumptions into prose.

text: Add a JSON type lens that prints runtime types, path grammar, and one known-good accessor for every field a verification script touches.
rationale: Path/str mismatches surface before bespoke assertion iterations.
trap: New type-lens helper for a one-off scripting error.

text: Make git diff the launch ramp: emit changed product inputs, affected tests, and the exact required packaging command, without suppressing commands.
rationale: Unchanged-product probes become visibly unnecessary while required tests remain proof.
trap: Changed-file set alone cannot determine required checks.

text: Collapse report navigation into a canonical pointer token—file, line, and anchor—generated read-only and pasted into final inspection.
rationale: Pointer inspection remains independent while hand-written link-resolution scripts disappear.
trap: New pointer token duplicates existing links.

text: When a prose assertion fails, surface its failing literal, producer test, and source owner beside the traceback.
rationale: Execution mistakes route directly to the contract without adding a report-validation gate.

text: Let workers attach prior command output by reference to acceptance context instead of replaying unchanged checks solely to quote results.
rationale: Evidence reuse becomes explicit and auditable while substantive checks remain unchanged.

text: Make each check a connect-the-dots picture: source promise → visible consequence → independent acceptance question.
rationale: A missing dot exposes a guidance gap; a broken dot exposes execution error without adding a second validation ritual.

text: Treat exact words like toy blocks: match them only when the source says the block’s shape matters; otherwise match the behavior built from them.
rationale: This separates contract-critical wording and model strings from brittle descriptive assertions without waiving substantive checks.

text: For every JSON check, ask the document a real path question and print the path with its answer before deciding true or false.
rationale: The output makes Path-versus-string mistakes immediately visible while preserving the actual value check.

text: When a checker fails, make it point to the first broken arrow—source, behavior, or report—instead of launching a new checker.
rationale: The next action becomes evidence-led repair, not an arbitrary retry or duplicate script.

text: Read the changed source and final report as one comic strip, then have acceptance read a different strip without borrowing its ending.
rationale: One inspection covers pointer/report coherence while acceptance stays independent and unchanged-product packaging work disappears.
trap: Different strip cannot replace independent whole-scope acceptance; no automatic packaging exemption.

text: Ask the worker to say “because” twice: the claim is true because the source says X, and the result is real because observation Y happened.
rationale: Two concrete reasons expose unsupported prose early while retaining source proof, behavioral proof, and final acceptance.
